name: Emiri Kato
bio: Emiri Kato (加藤 英美里, Katō Emiri, November 26, 1983) is a Japanese voice actress and singer from Fussa, Tokyo. She is affiliated with Stardust Promotion. Previously, she had been affiliated with 81 Produce since her debut until January 31, 2022.
